categories.name: utils
categories.evidence: Modifies `BufferedWriter` in `src/streams.h`, fixing an exception safety issue in a core stream utility.
categories.rationale: Fixes an unhandled exception in `BufferedWriter`'s destructor that leads to `std::terminate` on disk write failure. Preventing destructor crashes during stream error unwinding improves primitive reliability across the node.

categories.name: validation
categories.evidence: Touches `src/node/blockstorage.cpp` to ensure block and undo writes catch disk errors gracefully rather than aborting.
categories.rationale: Restores crash safety and clean storage failure handling when writing blocks or undo data to a full disk. Disk write failures in `BlockManager::WriteBlock` and `WriteBlockUndo` were triggering `std::terminate` instead of normal fatal error handling.
